tools.name: planetscale_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the service token can see. Start here to find the organization name. GET /v1/organizations.

tools.name: planetscale_get_organization
tools.description: Get one organization: name, plan and settings. GET /v1/organizations/{organization}.

tools.name: planetscale_list_public_regions
tools.description: List the PlanetScale regions and their cloud providers. Public endpoint: GET /v1/regions.

tools.name: planetscale_list_databases
tools.description: List the databases in an organization, with their state and kind (Postgres or MySQL). GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/databases.

tools.name: planetscale_get_database
tools.description: Get one database: state, default branch, regions and settings. GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/databases/{database}.

tools.name: planetscale_list_branches
tools.description: List the branches of a database, with ready state and whether each is a production branch. GET .../databases/{database}/branches.

tools.name: planetscale_get_branch
tools.description: Get one branch: ready state, parent branch, region and access host. GET .../branches/{branch}.

tools.name: planetscale_get_branch_schema
tools.description: Get the CREATE statements (schema only, no table data) of a branch. GET .../branches/{branch}/schema.

tools.name: planetscale_list_branch_backups
tools.description: List the backups of a branch, with state and time. GET .../branches/{branch}/backups.

tools.name: planetscale_list_deploy_requests
tools.description: List schema change deploy requests of a database, with state and branches. GET .../deploy-requests.

tools.name: planetscale_get_deploy_request
tools.description: Get one deploy request by its number: state, diff summary and deployment status. GET .../deploy-requests/{number}.

tools.name: planetscale_create_branch
tools.description: Create a development branch from a parent branch (default main). Creates billable resources; it does not change production. POST .../branches.

tools.name: planetscale_create_deploy_request
tools.description: Open a deploy request that merges schema changes from a branch into another branch. Opening it does not deploy; a person must review and deploy it. POST .../deploy-requests.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: planetscale_create_deploy_request · Private data: planetscale_list_organizations, planetscale_get_database, planetscale_list_branches, planetscale_list_deploy_requests · Public sink: planetscale_create_branch, planetscale_create_deploy_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: planetscale_create_deploy_request · Private data: planetscale_list_organizations, planetscale_get_database, planetscale_list_branches, planetscale_list_deploy_requests · Public sink: planetscale_create_branch, planetscale_create_deploy_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
